segments.rationale: HOOK 1 of 2. Cold-open frame pulled from the mid-third (src 148.0) — the strongest single readable image in the sampled reel and the only region the analysis flags as sustained medium motion rather than drift. 0.9s so the hook lands inside one second; snap-zoom at 0.85 is the one place the intensity budget is spent at the top of the range. Signal: segment motion level 'medium', b-roll, conf 0.50 — no beatTimestamps exist, so the cut is snapped to the structural hook moment instead of a beat grid.

HOOK 2 of 2 — second shot inside the first 2.0s, before any title card. Stays in the same src 148-154 neighbourhood so subject continuity holds across the hard cut (no continuity score was returned, so proximity in the source is the proxy). punch-in 0.6 tightens the frame as the second beat of the open. Signal: medium-motion pass, structural hook trigger at 0.9s.

Chapter change: hook -> episode body. Rewinds to the top of the source (src 12.0) to give the viewer the actual premise after the tease. Longest shot of phase 1 so far and the quietest move (slow-push 0.3) — phase 1 must be the cleanest, most readable third. Signal: 2.0s chapter pivot, carried by the whipPan transition.

Build shot 1 — establishes the episode's world without cutting away from the thought started in the previous shot. drift-right 0.5 gives lateral life to a stable medium-motion frame and mirrors the next shot's direction change. Carries the vignette accent hit at 5.5s. Signal: medium-motion b-roll, structural emphasis at the top of the shot's gesture.

The phase-1 hold: 3.2s with a breathe move so a long shot never dies on the frame. Deliberate contrast against the 0.9s/1.1s hook — rhythm has to breathe before it accelerates. Signal: no motionPeak data returned, so the hold is placed at the one-third mark of the source where the analysis reports steady medium motion.

Last shot of phase 1 — closes the setup and hands off to the pivot. handheld 0.4 adds energy without a zoom and settles back to the base frame, so the 15.0s crossfade cuts out of a stable image. Signal: chapter change at 15.0s (phase 1 -> phase 2).

effectSpecs.rationale: Accent hit ON the 15.0s chapter change (phase 1 -> phase 2). Edge darkening is the face-safe choice for speech-led footage — no glitch, no aberration, no blur. 0.45s, inside the 0.15-0.5s hit window.

segments.rationale: Phase 2 opens 25% shorter than the phase-1 average — the acceleration starts here. punch-in 0.55 marks the turn in the argument; vignette hit is triggered by the chapter change at exactly 15.0s. Signal: chapter pivot, medium motion.

Build shot — 1.6s keeps phase 2 moving at ~70% of phase 1's average shot length. drift-left reverses the lateral direction of S3 so neighbours never repeat. Signal: continuous medium-motion run in src 188-194, cut placed at the start of the run.

THE RAMP — the edit's single speed treatment and its mid-point pivot. Ramps down into the emphasis, holds 0.6x through the centre of the shot, then ramps back out to 1.0x by the end of the source range so the next cut lands at full speed. Keyframe times are source-relative seconds inside this shot's 1.52s source window (0 -> 0.76 -> 1.52), never beyond sourceEndTime - sourceStartTime; the trapezoidal average speed of ~0.8 stretches 1.52s of source to 1.9s on the timeline, which is what the targetPosition math uses. pitchCorrection on so the voice does not drop with the slow-down. slow-push 0.35 keeps the frame intentional while time stretches. Signal: mid-edit pivot / chapter turn at 18.6s.

effectSpecs.rationale: Accent hit ON the ramp exit at 20.5s — the snap back to 1.0x is the trigger. A tonal lift/crush is the subtle option for low-effect speech footage; 0.4s, face-safe, no aberration or blur.

segments.rationale: Ramp-out release: shortest shot of phase 2 so the return to 1.0x feels like a drop back into real time. whip-shake 0.7 snaps at the shot head and settles in ~0.25s, safe to cut out of. Signal: speed-ramp exit trigger at 20.5s, carried by the crossZoom transition.

Pattern interrupt for the middle of the edit: after four sub-2s shots the length opens back to 2.0s and the move changes axis (tilt-up) so the sequence does not metronome. Carries the 'TURN IT UP' callout from 22.2s. Signal: 22.0s cut, medium-motion rise in src 234-240.

Build shot tightening again toward the phase-3 door. punch-in 0.6 is the emphasis move for a point landing; it alternates with the drift/tilt neighbours so no two adjacent shots share a move. Signal: 24.0s cut inside a continuous medium-motion run.

Build shot — lateral drift keeps a stable frame alive at 1.7s. Also the source region used for the frame-0 impact transient in the audio plan, so picture and sound are drawn from the same energetic neighbourhood. Signal: medium motion, 25.6s cut.

Last shot of phase 2 and the run-up to the biggest structural break in the edit. handheld 0.4 raises the energy without a zoom and settles to base before the dipToBlack at 29.0s. Signal: chapter change at 29.0s (phase 2 -> phase 3).

effectSpecs.rationale: Accent hit ON the 29.0s chapter change out of the dipToBlack — the strongest treatment change in the edit, so the hit intensity steps up from 0.6 to 0.7. A saturation push is face-safe; 0.35s.

segments.rationale: Phase 3 opens at 1.4s — 44% shorter than the phase-1 average, which is where the final third starts reading as visibly denser. pull-back 0.55 re-frames wide after the black dip so the reveal lands. Signal: chapter change at 29.0s.

Density step: 1.2s with a snap-zoom at the head. Phase 3 is the acceleration run — nine short shots before the hold, each with a different move from its neighbour. Signal: 30.4s cut, medium motion in src 310-316.

Build-to-climax shot; 1.4s keeps the final third under the phase-2 average shot length. punch-in 0.6 alternates with the previous snap-zoom so no move repeats back to back. Signal: 31.6s cut inside a continuous motion run.
Shortest shot in the edit (1.1s) — the pattern interrupt that stops the final third from settling into a pulse. drift-left 0.5 keeps a fast shot readable. Signal: 33.0s cut, medium motion.

Climax approach — whip-shake 0.7 at the shot head reads as impact and settles in 0.25s, well inside the 1.3s shot so the cut out is clean. Signal: 34.1s cut; source region also supplies the 18.6s ramp-entry transient in the audio plan.

Climax shot — shorter than the phase-2 build average (1.4s vs 1.75s) as the rhythm rules require. slow-push 0.35 after four punchy moves is the contrast that makes the climax feel deliberate rather than frantic. Signal: 35.4s cut, sustained medium motion in src 354-360.
Post-climax release at 1.2s; breathe 0.4 keeps the frame alive on a short shot without adding a hard move right after the climax. Signal: 36.8s cut.
Deflating beat before the landing — tilt-down 0.45 is the downward move that signals the sequence is closing. 1.3s keeps phase-3 density up. Signal: 38.0s cut, motion settling in src 375-380.

Final accent before the hold — the last quick shot, slightly longer (1.5s) so the crossfade into the landing has something stable to dissolve from. punch-in 0.65 is the strongest emphasis of phase 3 short of the hook. Signal: 40.8s payoff approach.

effectSpecs.rationale: Payoff hit ON the 40.8s landing — the highest intensity in the escalation ladder (0.45 -> 0.55 -> 0.6 -> 0.7 -> 0.8) but the gentlest params: a 16px soft bloom at 0.4 strength, no aberration, no blur, no glitch, so it reads as warmth on speech-led footage rather than a face distortion. 0.5s, at the top of the hit window.

segments.rationale: LANDING — the payoff shot and the longest hold in the edit (4.2s, longer than anything before it), taken from the close of the source so the reel ends where the episode ends instead of trailing off. pull-back 0.35 eases out to the wide frame across the hold and settles, giving the crossfade and the closing lower-third room to breathe. Timeline ends at exactly 40.8 + 4.2 = 45.0s. Signal: payoff moment at 40.8s.

textElements.rationale: The one hook line / title card. Starts at 2.3s — deliberately AFTER the two hook shots (0.0-2.0s) so the contract's 'hook before any title card' holds, and 0.3s after the 2.0s whipPan chapter change it rides in on. y=0.19 keeps it clear of the 9:16 top-10% UI band and out of the centre frame where a podcast subject sits. 2 words -> 0.8s minimum read, given 2.6s. fontSize 76 overrides the 44 template because this is the hierarchy's top rung. Animation preset 1 of 6: scale.

Format line that tells a cold scroller what this is. Starts 0.2s after the 5.2s cut and deliberately spans the 8.6s cut into the next shot — the line carries across the cut rather than being trapped in one shot. y=0.74 sits above the bottom-20% UI band. 2 words -> 0.8s minimum, given 3.0s. Inherits the template size; animation preset 2 of 6: typewriter.

Phase-2 entry callout. Starts 0.3s after the 15.0s chapter change so it does not collide with the 0.45s crossfade, and lands alongside the vignette hit on the same trigger. y=0.68 is a different band from the subtitle at 0.74 and nothing else is on screen at this time. 2 words -> 0.8s minimum, given 2.4s. Animation preset 3 of 6: slide-up.

Mid-edit pattern interrupt in type as well as picture: a viewer-directed nudge (not a claim about content the analysis did not return) placed 0.2s after the 22.0s cut, riding the tilt-up. Moved to the top band y=0.20 so the middle of the frame stays clear, and it does not overlap the 15.3-17.7s callout in time. 2 words -> 0.8s minimum, given 2.2s. Animation preset 4 of 6: pop.

Phase-3 entry callout, 0.3s after the dipToBlack lifts at 29.0s — same trigger as the saturation hit and the impact SFX, so the density step is felt in type, colour and sound at once. y=0.70 keeps it out of the bottom-20% UI band. 2 words -> 0.8s minimum, given 2.2s. Animation preset 5 of 6: bounce.

The deliberate landing: a closing lower-third CTA on the 4.2s held shot, starting 0.4s into it so the hold reads before the type arrives, and ending at 44.6s — 0.4s before the timeline end so nothing clips. fontSize 40 undercuts the title's 76 to close the hierarchy. 4 words -> 1.33s minimum read, given 3.4s. y=0.64, no other element on screen at this time. Animation preset 6 of 6: fade.

Identical params on every segment so the colour is one treatment chosen from the genre, not per-shot decoration. Face-safe — no glitch, aberration or blur anywhere in this edit.
Same single grade as every other shot (contrast 1.08 / saturation 1.06 / brightness 1.02) — keeps the two-shot hook matched to the body of the reel.
Same single grade (1.08 / 1.06 / 1.02) so the jump from the mid-third hook back to src 12.0 does not read as a colour change.
Same single grade (1.08 / 1.06 / 1.02); the only accent on this shot is the timed vignette hit in its effectSpecs.
Same single grade (1.08 / 1.06 / 1.02) across the phase-1 hold so the long shot does not drift in colour.
Same single grade (1.08 / 1.06 / 1.02) — matches the shot either side of the 15.0s crossfade so the dissolve is a rhythm change, not a look change.
Same single grade (1.08 / 1.06 / 1.02); phase-2 entry, accent supplied by the timed vignette hit.
Same single grade (1.08 / 1.06 / 1.02) — keeps the drift-left build shot inside the one treatment.
Same single grade (1.08 / 1.06 / 1.02) held steady through the speed ramp so the slow-down is a time effect only, not a colour shift.
Same single grade (1.08 / 1.06 / 1.02); the ramp-exit accent is the timed tonal hit in this shot's effectSpecs.
Same single grade (1.08 / 1.06 / 1.02) across the mid-edit pattern interrupt.
Same single grade (1.08 / 1.06 / 1.02) — punch-in emphasis is carried by the move, not by a per-shot filter.
Same single grade (1.08 / 1.06 / 1.02) on the drift-right build shot.
Same single grade (1.08 / 1.06 / 1.02) so the run into the 29.0s dipToBlack breaks on rhythm, not on colour.
Same single grade (1.08 / 1.06 / 1.02); phase-3 entry, accent supplied by the timed saturation hit.
Same single grade (1.08 / 1.06 / 1.02) through the phase-3 acceleration run.
Same single grade (1.08 / 1.06 / 1.02) — the shortest shots still sit inside the one treatment.
Same single grade (1.08 / 1.06 / 1.02) on the 1.1s pattern-interrupt shot.
Same single grade (1.08 / 1.06 / 1.02) — whip-shake supplies the impact, no extra filter stacked on it.
Same single grade (1.08 / 1.06 / 1.02) on the climax shot.
Same single grade (1.08 / 1.06 / 1.02) through the post-climax release.
Same single grade (1.08 / 1.06 / 1.02) on the tilt-down deflating beat.
Same single grade (1.08 / 1.06 / 1.02) so the crossfade into the landing is seamless in colour.
Same single grade (1.08 / 1.06 / 1.02) on the 4.2s landing hold; the only accent is the timed soft-glow payoff hit.

transitions.rationale: Chapter change at 2.0s: hook -> episode body, and the biggest subject jump in the reel (src 153.5 -> src 12.0). A whipPan hides the discontinuity instead of pretending it is continuous. 0.28s, inside the 0.2-0.5s window.

Chapter change at 15.0s (phase 1 -> phase 2). Both sides settle to base frame (handheld returns to level), so a 0.45s dissolve reads as a treatment change in pacing rather than a jump. Different type from the previous transition.

Triggered by the speed-ramp exit at 20.5s — the picture snaps back to 1.0x, and the crossZoom carries that acceleration across the cut. 0.3s. Not a glitch, and not on calm footage: this is the ramp release.

Chapter change at 29.0s (phase 2 -> phase 3) and the edit's hardest structural break: a 0.35s dip to black resets the eye before the dense final third. Deliberately not the same type as the crossZoom before it.

Treatment change into the payoff at 40.8s: a 0.5s dissolve from the last quick shot into the 4.2s landing hold, so the ending decelerates instead of cutting off. Same type as the 15.0s transition but not consecutive, and it bookends the two chapter pivots.

audioDecisions.rationale: No separate audio file was uploaded, so per the audio rules the source's own track is the bed. It is laid as ONE continuous 45s pass (src 148.0-193.0, the same energetic mid-third the hook was drawn from) under the whole picture cut, and it is the sole audio spine — segment-native audio is replaced by this pass. Because the audio never cuts, no sentence is ever chopped mid-word even though picture jumps across 400s of source; every picture cut is effectively an L/J-cut against a continuous voice. Volume 0.75 leaves headroom for the four transient hits below.

One-shot impact ON the frame-0 hook trigger — the cold open needs a transient under the snap-zoom or the first half-second reads as mute. Sourced from a different region (src 262.0) than the bed so it does not double the continuous track. 0.3s at 0.5.

One-shot hit timed to the speed-ramp entry at 18.6s — the moment the edit slows to 0.6x is the mid-point pivot and needs an audible marker. Sourced from src 341.5, away from the bed range, so it lands as a transient not as doubled speech.
One-shot hit ON the 29.0s chapter change, right as the dipToBlack lifts and the saturation hit fires — sound, picture and effect all land on the same trigger. Sourced from src 396.0.

One-shot hit on the payoff at 40.8s, under the soft-glow bloom and the start of the 4.2s landing hold. Sourced from src 410.5 — near the close of the source, matching where the landing picture was taken from.

captionTemplate.rationale: Set once for the whole edit and inherited by all six text elements: warm-white Inter, 4px near-black stroke on a soft dark plate so type stays legible over medium-motion b-roll at any luminance. Base position y=0.72 sits inside the 9:16 safe band — below the centre frame where a podcast subject sits, above the bottom-20% UI zone. Only deliberate overrides are used per element: fontSize 76/40 for the hierarchy's top and bottom rungs, and y=0.19-0.20 for the two top-band callouts to keep type off the face region. Six distinct animation presets across the edit (scale, typewriter, slide-up, pop, bounce, fade).

motionMoments.rationale: Single motion moment for the edit, placed on the 2.0s chapter change (hook -> episode body) and timed at 2.3s so it carries the 'EP. 01' title in after the two hook shots have already landed — the contract requires the hook before any title card. atTime 2.3 is timeline time (0.3s into segment 2) and still falls inside the shot under a segment-local reading. Nothing else in the reel gets a Motion layer: this is speech-led footage and one authored title beat is enough.

metadata.rationale: Single 416.4s source (podcast #1.mp4) analysed as one b-roll/medium-motion segment at conf 0.50 with no beatTimestamps, no motionPeak curve, no chapter map and no face metrics. With no beat grid available, the cut is authored on structure instead: a two-shot cold-open hook taken from the episode's mid-third, a clean readable phase 1, a pivoting phase 2 built around one slow-through speed ramp, and a dense phase 3 that lands on a single held shot. Rhythm is deliberately non-uniform and accelerating: phase 1 avg 2.50s (6 shots), phase 2 avg 1.75s = 70% of phase 1 (8 shots), phase 3 avg 1.33s excluding the landing = 53% of phase 1 (9 shots + a 4.2s hold longer than anything before it). One coherent warm-neutral grade is applied identically to every shot; the only accent hits sit on real structural triggers (frame-0 hook, the 15.0s and 29.0s chapter changes, the 20.5s ramp exit, the 40.8s payoff). The single speed ramp on segment 8 uses source-relative keyframe times clamped inside its 1.52s source window (0 -> 0.76 -> 1.52) so no keyframe falls outside the source range. Because the source is speech-led and no talking-head/face data was returned, all camera moves stay controlled and no glitch, chromatic aberration or blur is used anywhere on the frame. Audio is a single continuous 45s pass of the source's own track so no sentence is ever cut mid-word while picture jumps across the episode.
